senses.gloss: कथ् [fr. कथम्, ‘to tell the how’; cf. Goth. qvith́an; Old High Germ. quethan and quedan; Eng. quoth and quote.]
कथक mfn. relating, reciting, Śāntiś.
कथक m. a narrator, relater, one who recites a story (or who publicly reads and expounds the Purāṇas &c.), one who speaks or tells, a professional story-teller, MBh.; Kathās. &c.
the speaker of a prologue or monologue, chief actor, L.
N. of a man
of a being in the retinue of Skanda.
काथक m. a son or descendant of Kathaka, Pravar.
कथन mfn. telling, talkative, W.
कथन n. the act of telling, narration, relating, informing, Suśr.; Bhartṛ.; Pañcat. &c.
कथनिक m. a narrator, story-teller, Hcar.
कथनीय mfn. to be said or told or declared, worthy of relation or mentioning, MBh.; BhP. &c.
to be called or named, Śrutab.
कथयान mfn. (ep. pres. p.) relating, telling, MBh. iii, 2906.
कथयितव्य mfn. to be told or mentioned
to be communicated, Śak. 233, 4.
1. कथा f. (for 2. See col. 3) conversation, speech, talking together, ĀśvGṛ.; MBh.; Mn. &c.
talk, mention

(का कथा [with gen. or more commonly with loc. and sometimes with प्रति], what should one say of? how should one speak of? e.g. एको ऽपि कृच्छ्राद् वर्तेत भूयसां तु कथैव का, even one person would live with difficulty, what should one say of many? i.e. how much more many? Kathās. iv, 123; का कथा बाण-संधाने, what mention of fitting the arrow? i.e. what necessity for fitting the arrow? Śak. 53 a)
story, tale, fable, MBh.; R.; Hit. &c.
a feigned story, tale (as one, of the species of poetical composition), Sāh. 567; Kāvyād.
Story (personified), Kathās.
(in log.) discussion, disputation, Sarvad.
2. कथा॑ ind. (for 1. See col. 1) (Ved. for कथ॑म्, Pāṇ. v, 3, 26) how? whence? why? RV.; AV. viii, 1, 16; TS. &c.
(यथा॑ कथा॑ च, in any way whatsoever, ŚBr. iv)
sometimes merely a particle of interrogation (e.g. कथा॑ शृणोति … इ॑न्द्रः, does Indra hear? RV. iv, 23, 3; कथा॑-कथा॑, whether-or? TS. ii, 6, 1, 7).

कथ॑म् ind. (fr. 2. क), how? in what manner? whence? (e.g. कथम् एतत्, how is that? कथम् इदानीम्, how now? what is now to be done? कथम् मारात्मके त्वयि विश्वासः, how can there be reliance on thee of murderous mind? कथम् उत्सृज्य त्वां गच्छेयम्, how can I go away deserting you? कथम् बुद्ध्वा भविष्यति सा, how will she be when she awakes? कथम् मृत्युः प्रभवति वेदविदाम्, whence is it that death has power over those that know the Veda? कथम् अवगम्यते, whence is it inferred?);

sometimes कथम् merely introduces an interrogation (e.g. कथम् आत्मानं निवेदयामि कथं वात्मापहारं करोमि, shall I declare myself or shall I withdraw?) कथम् is often found in connection with the particles इव, नाम, नु, स्विद्, which appear to generalize the interrogation (how possibly? how indeed? &c.)

with नु it is sometimes = किमु, or कुतस् (e.g. कथं नु, how much more! न कथं नु, how much less!) कथम् is often connected, like किम्, with the particles चन, चिद्, and अपि, which give an indefinite sense to the interrogative (e.g. कथं चन, in any way, some how; scarcely, with difficulty; न कथं चन, in no way at all; कथंचित्, some how or other, by some means or other, in any way, with some difficulty, scarcely, in a moderate degree, a little; न कथंचित्, not at all, in no way whatever; न कथंचिद् न, in no way not i.e. most decidedly; यथा कथंचित्, in any way whatsoever; कथंचिद् यदि जीवति, it is with difficulty that he lives; कथम् अपि, some how or other, with some difficulty, scarcely a little; कथम् अपि न, by no means, not at all), RV. &c.
according to lexicographers कथम् is a particle implying amazement
surprise
pleasure
abuse.
कथं (in comp. for कथम्; at the beginning of an adjective compound it may also have the sense of किम्).
